notes: The list of controls used to run across the bottom of every frame and never leave. It was the brightest thing on screen, so the first thing you read was a keyboard reference instead of the world in front of you.
Now it shows itself, gives you time to read it, and then fades out and leaves you the picture.
It comes back on its own the moment it is actually useful again: pick up a controller and it returns, showing the controller's buttons rather than the keyboard's.
If you want it back at any other time, press H — there is a small marker in the bottom corner that says so, and it stays there. Press H again to put it away.
The heads-up display also takes its colours and lettering from the game's own palette now, instead of keeping a second copy of them, so the two can no longer drift apart.
Still plain: this is text over the world, not the framed, worked-metal panels the interface is aiming for. That is separate work.
The fading controls are a preview: set WAR_CONTEXTUAL_HINTS=1 before launch to try them.
title: The controls step out of the way once you have read them
